name: Bpartnerlocation is one row per address, system row included
note:
Two assertions in one number. The cube must not fan out - its four LEFT JOINs to c_location, c_region, c_country and c_shippingregion are all to unique keys - and its policy must be IN (tenant, 0), not tenant only.

The policy first said tenant only, on the stated assumption that 'there are no ad_client_id = 0 rows in c_bpartner_location'. There is exactly one, id 1035455, and the cube returned 20,585 against a true 20,586. An assumption written as a fact and never checked - the same shape as the 2022 model losing every system-owned row.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM c_bpartner_location WHERE ad_client_id IN (1000026,0)
